Container.Name: scrcpy-web
Container.Overview: Control an Android phone plugged into your Unraid server from any browser (including iPhone Safari) or VNC app, using scrcpy. Includes wake/unlock buttons, typing and pasting text, screenshots, and an HTTP API for automations. Enable USB debugging on the phone, plug it in, start the container and accept the "Allow USB debugging" prompt.

Config.Name: Web password
Config.Description: Password for the web UI. Leave empty to have one generated (shown in the container log).

Config.Name: USB bus
Config.Description: USB access for ADB. Keep as is.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: ADB keys, generated passwords and sessions

Config.Name: Allowed networks
Config.Description: Client addresses allowed to connect. 'private' = local network ranges only. Narrow to your subnet (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24) for extra safety. Never set to 'any'.

Config.Name: Unlock PIN
Config.Description: Optional PIN used by the Unlock button

Config.Name: API token
Config.Description: Optional bearer token for the HTTP API (automations, iOS Shortcuts, Home Assistant)

Config.Name: Max video size
Config.Description: Longest side of the mirrored video in pixels (0 = native)

Config.Name: Stay awake
Config.Description: Keep the phone awake while plugged in

Config.Name: Turn phone screen off
Config.Description: Turn the phone's own screen off while mirroring

Config.Name: Wake on connect
Config.Description: Wake the phone when the web UI is opened

Config.Name: Device serial
Config.Description: Only needed if more than one Android device is connected

Config.Name: VNC password
Config.Description: Set to open the native VNC port (max 8 characters)

Config.Name: VNC port
Config.Description: Native VNC (only used when a VNC password is set)
